notes: The module-root breadcrumb for Administration and Data Integration must use the same effective-permission child resolution as the sidebar/root landing behavior. It must not send a user to Backups or Imports merely because those were historical defaults. Legacy admin/data-operations routes are excluded because they resolve into the Operations surface. Backend authorization and role semantics are unchanged.
